verdict.rationale: Cake documents a few built-in event-driven automations: it can automatically notify your registered agent when shares are issued, transferred or converted, and it offers automated board sign-off flows and automated vesting events. These are preset behaviours you switch on or configure, not a general rule engine. The MCP connection is read-only and no API was found, so there is no programmable way to trigger actions. Missing for 10: a user-defined rule builder (custom triggers, conditions and actions), webhooks or an API for programmatic automation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
